purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-hoshuu) billing system - accounts receivable / payment collection list screen (S02)
purpose.summary: This program implements the payment/collection list screen (ORCGS02, S02) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It manages patient billing records, outstanding balances, payment entry, and receipt re-issuance for both outpatient and inpatient cases. It handles complex Japanese medical insurance billing logic including multiple insurance combinations, disaster insurance, and self-pay calculations.

notable_features: 86 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
645 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Large SPA (scratchpad area) working storage with OCCURS tables up to 500 entries
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Fixed-format source with max line length 76
verdict.notes: File is 411KB / 10242 lines - a large production program. Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake in the snippet. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Program type classified as online-cics equivalent but actually uses a proprietary screen/event framework (not CICS) typical of ORCA's GnuCOBOL-based architecture. Source truncated at 16000 chars; full procedure division not visible but indicators confirm full COBOL structure.
